topology_reasoning: The black material forms two disconnected optical waveguides.  The upper-left guide descends through an S bend to a near-parallel upper interaction guide, then rises through a mirrored S bend to the upper-right port.  The lower-left guide follows the vertically mirrored route into a lower interaction guide and returns to the lower-right port.  In the central region the guides are separated by a small gap; the upper guide gradually narrows while the lower guide gradually widens.  This is the recognizable topology of an asymmetric directional/adiabatic coupler: the S bends bring the modes together, and the tapered, close parallel section controls the supermode evolution and power transfer.

function_defining_knobs.port_separation: vertical separation of the access ports
function_defining_knobs.s_bend_length: horizontal extent of each approach/departure S bend
function_defining_knobs.s_bend_offset: vertical displacement from an access port to an interaction guide
function_defining_knobs.bend_radius: minimum radius used by each Euler S bend
function_defining_knobs.coupling_gap: edge-to-edge separation in the interaction region
function_defining_knobs.upper_width_start: upper-guide width at the left interaction boundary
function_defining_knobs.upper_width_end: upper-guide width at the right interaction boundary
function_defining_knobs.lower_width_start: lower-guide width at the left interaction boundary
function_defining_knobs.lower_width_end: lower-guide width at the right interaction boundary
function_defining_knobs.taper_length: linear transition length between access guide and interaction widths

iterations.change_made: Initial parametric two-guide reconstruction: sigmoid S-bend centerlines, access tapers, and linearly tapered interaction guides.
Tested a lateral mid-bend dwell to reproduce the broad curved silhouette; it introduced self-offset artifacts and was rejected.
Added smooth primitive Path width flares in the S bends; retained as the prior best after the next test.
Tested shifted sigmoid curve centers independently by arm; the broad flare and frame alignment degraded, so this parameterization was rejected.
Replaced broad sinusoidal S-bend flares with independently centered Gaussian width flares inferred from the red/blue mismatch. This is the retained final layout.
